findings.title: tests-external-tools formal regression 引入 POSIX-only path 与 ambient zip/unzip prerequisite
findings.problem: 040 将 C1 exact managed external-tool proof 纳入 formal `tests-external-tools`，但该 selected regression 自身不是 platform/detached deterministic。`tests/unit/external-tools/managed-tool.test.ts` 的 `requiredFlowkitHome()` 以 `value.startsWith('/')` 作为 managed fixture 条件，这只接受 POSIX path，合法 Windows absolute `FLOWKIT_HOME` 会在进入 production resolver 前被测试直接拒绝。`tests/integration/c1-external-tool-runtime-and-archify-cli-contract.test.ts` 的 synthetic review ZIP 场景又直接 `spawnSync('zip')` / `spawnSync('unzip')`，依赖未冻结、未归一化的 ambient host commands。040 formal Verification 在当前 Linux host 上因为 `/usr/bin/zip`/`unzip` 恰好存在而 passed，但这不是 C1 exact managed runtime identity 的一部分。
findings.contractRef: 038 approved Proposal/Design tasks 1.3, 2.2-2.4, 3.5, 4.2-4.4, 5.5; 029 Explore Risk Scan/Proof 6; 03 C1 detached-offline + Windows compatibility boundary; repository platform-launcher operating contract
findings.invariant: C1 的 formal physical regression 必须证明 exact managed OpenSpec/Archify 能在受控 detached/offline 环境工作，并保持项目支持的 Windows path/launcher semantics；selected test 本身不得因 POSIX-only path assertion 或未声明 ambient POSIX utility 而把 host coincidence 变成隐藏 verification prerequisite。
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Apply so the C1 formal external-tool regressions are platform-safe and do not depend on undeclared ambient POSIX zip/unzip availability. Remove the POSIX-only `startsWith('/')` fixture assumption in favor of the same cross-platform absolute-path contract used by production. Rework the synthetic ZIP physical proof so it has a deterministic cross-platform execution contract (or otherwise a formally declared/normalized test prerequisite) without changing C1 product scope, Tool Registry policy, or D1/E1 authority boundary.
acceptance: A valid Windows-shaped `FLOWKIT_HOME` is not rejected by test-only POSIX path logic; the test validates the production cross-platform absolute-path contract rather than `/` prefix semantics.
The synthetic review ZIP regression no longer assumes ambient `zip`/`unzip` binaries with no platform contract; its create + integrity proof is deterministic for supported execution environments.
Re-running `tests-external-tools` with exact managed OpenSpec/Archify and without accidental POSIX ZIP utilities does not fail solely because of host PATH contents.

Existing managed OpenSpec/Archify doctor/validate/deliver/compare, last-good preservation, no formal `architecture/**` authority, Windows OpenSpec shim compatibility, managed/legacy retry and formal Verification selection regressions remain green.

A new formal Change Verification publication is generated from the revised exact candidate; 035 failed and 040 passed publications remain immutable historical point-in-time facts according to current verification-history rules.
